scope: Zero-shot variant ranking on 19 DMS assays excluded from pretraining; single- and multi-substitution variants as available.
ordering: values and published_values rows follow assays; columns follow models (source figure ascending mean, ProTEUS last).

aggregation.figure_rule: Missing or undefined Spearman values are zero-filled before taking the unweighted mean across all 19 assays.
aggregation.sem_rule: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the same 19 zero-filled values, divided by sqrt(19).
aggregation.heatmap_rule: Use values, where missing or undefined metrics are null; do not display these cells as measured zero correlations.
aggregation.missing_reconstruction: The distributed source matrix already contains zero fills. Four null cells are restored using the explicitly documented per-model zero-fill counts, the four and only four zeros in that source table, and the independently supplied observed-only sample counts and means. Missing/undefined does not by itself imply that a model was not run.
aggregation.statistical_claim: Highest mean is descriptive; no claim of a significant difference from every comparator.
